author: M. R. Ponder
title: City of Eagle seeks applicant for Parks, Pathways and Recreation Commission
text:
The City of Eagle announced on June 3 that it is seeking an individual to fill one opening on the Parks, Pathways, and Recreation Commission. The commission meets on the third Thursday of every month at 5:30 p.m. at City Hall, with special meetings scheduled as needed.
This volunteer position will be filled by recommendation from the Mayor and subsequent approval by the City Council. Interested applicants are required to submit a Request for Consideration Form online. A resume or curriculum vitae is encouraged but not mandatory.
Applications must be submitted online no later than 5:00 p.m., Mountain Standard Time (MST), on Friday, June 19, 2026.
Further information about the commission opening and application process can be found through official city channels.
